linux.capture_method: Local linux/amd64 Docker container under Colima on macOS; GitHub Actions unavailable because of billing limit

dockerfile.content:
FROM --platform=linux/amd64 ubuntu:24.04
RUN apt-get update && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    curl git unzip xz-utils zip ca-certificates libglu1-mesa python3 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN curl -fsSL https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_3.44.8-stable.tar.xz \
    | tar -xJ -C /opt
ENV PATH=/opt/flutter/bin:$PATH
RUN git config --global --add safe.directory '*' && flutter --version && flutter precache --no-android --no-ios --linux
